questions.question: Specify the library in the 1691 sentence: this was the Herzog August Library in Wolfenbüttel, held alongside his Hanover post. Without naming the town, the paragraph’s Hanover context can make it sound like the same library. Approve a brief clarification in both versions. Institutional source: https://www.hab.de/leibnizressourcen-digital/ .

localizations.ru: Уточнить библиотеку в абзаце о 1691 годе: речь о Герцогской библиотеке Августа в Вольфенбюттеле, которой Лейбниц руководил одновременно с ганноверской службой. Без названия города после начала абзаца о Ганновере можно принять её за ту же библиотеку. Согласовать краткое уточнение в обеих версиях. Первичный институциональный источник: https://www.hab.de/leibnizressourcen-digital/ .

questions.resolution: Both versions now identify the institution as the Herzog August Library in Wolfenbüttel.

questions.question: Establish a working public link to the English translation of Explanation of Binary Arithmetic and verify the dates of the text’s preparation and publication.

localizations.source: Establish a working public link to the English translation of Explanation of Binary Arithmetic and verify the dates of the text’s preparation and publication.
localizations.ru: Установить действующую публичную ссылку на английский перевод Explanation of Binary Arithmetic и сверить даты подготовки текста и публикации.

questions.resolution: A working public translation by Lloyd Strickland is linked; the articles also distinguish preparation in 1703 from publication in 1705: https://leibniz-translations.com/binary ; https://www.leibnizpapers.org/binary-theodicy.htm .

questions.question: For the two portraits of Leibniz after Francke, identify a verifiable original and the applicable legal basis or licence.
